{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patients by keeping only the highest sample_seq per patient
df_clean = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Verify the cleaning: should now have 424 unique patients (since 848 total rows, 2 per patient)
print(f"Number of unique patients after cleaning: {df_clean['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Now compute the mean of the baseline biomarker
mean_baseline = df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value: {mean_baseline}")"}
